services.h1: AI video editing, from generated shots to a finished story
services.intro: I specialize in AI video editing. I build videos with AI tools like Higgsfield, then do the part the tools can't: pick the shots that work, keep the characters consistent, cut to the voice or the beat, and add captions, sound and colour so the result feels made, not generated.

AI music videos with scenes and lyrics cut to the beat
Generation with tools like Higgsfield, plus a proper edit in Premiere Pro and After Effects
Sound design, captions and colour so AI shots sit together as one film
Mixing AI shots with your real footage when the project needs both
process: You send the idea, script or song and tell me where it will be posted.
We agree on the length, the style, the deadline and the price before I start.
I generate the shots, build the edit and send a first cut. You leave notes, I revise.
You get the final files in every ratio you need: 9:16, 1:1, 16:9.
faq: What is AI video editing?
It's editing where some or all of the shots are made with AI tools instead of a camera. The tools make the clips; the editing is what turns them into a story people watch to the end.
Which AI tools do you use?
Tools like Higgsfield for the AI shots, then Adobe Premiere Pro and After Effects for the edit, captions, sound and colour.
Can you make an AI music video for my song?
Yes. Send the song and the mood you want. I'll build scenes and characters around it and cut them to the beat, with the lyrics on screen if you want them.
How much does it cost?

It depends on the project: the length, how much footage or generation is needed, the deadline and the level of polish. Every project balances cheap, fast and quality. Send me what you have and I'll reply with a quote.
